```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

opens the data set
```{r}
birds_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(birds_breeding_sites)
```
```{r}
colnames(birds_breeding_sites)
glimpse(birds_breeding_sites)
```
```{r}
print(dim(birds_breeding_sites))
migration_sites <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migration_sites))
glimpse(migration_sites)
```
glimpse fucntion shows us that there are 100 rows and 34 columns
data type for tag is character
data type for birth is numerical
```{r}
colnames(migration_sites)
```
here we are selcting which variables of the data we want using select and distinct to ensure we have no repeats and renaming columns

```{r}
birds_breeding_selected <- birds_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_longitude = Longitude, Breeding_latitude = Latitude)

gt(birds_breeding_selected)
```
```{r}
birds_migration_selected <- migration_sites |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_longitude = pslon, Stopover_latitude = pslat, Iberian_longitude = iblon, Iberian_latitude = iblat, Westmost_longitude = awestlon, Westmost_latitude = awestlat)

gt(birds_migration_selected)
```
now we will exclude any data with the site = spain
```{r}
birds_breeding_exc <- birds_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(birds_breeding_exc)

birds_migration_exc <- birds_migration_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(head(birds_migration_exc))
```
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- birds_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |> 
  summarise(
    Stopover_longitude = median(Stopover_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_latitude = median(Stopover_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_longitude = median(Iberian_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_latitude = median(Iberian_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_longitude = median(Westmost_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_latitude = median(Westmost_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_longitude = median(Winter_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_latitude = median(Winter_latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_migration_summary, birds_breeding_exc)
gt(combined_bird_data)

```
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_longitude", "_latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
    )
  
  
gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

```{r}
spring_values <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_values <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")
spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_values)
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_values)

write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
gt(spring_data)
```
```{r}
min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(longitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lon)
max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(longitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lon)
min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(latitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lat)
max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(latitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lat)

ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, colour = Site, shape=Location_Type)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat +2)
  ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
    
```
